purpose: Exhaust every explicit retained exact-score implication into the aligned full-game result market before selecting any current book request.

retained_source.capture_role: immutable retained public Gamma response; displayed prices are rejection-only

required_common_rule_fragments: The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers.
required_zero_zero_cancellation_fragment: if it is canceled with no make-up game, the market resolves to "0-0."
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve to "Yes".
